_comment: Trials course sets (ordered, played once). Read by TrialsMode._load_course_set (set id from MatchConfig.circuit_id; empty => 'campaign'). Level-designer authors courses under levels/courses/ and lists them here in difficulty order.

varied._comment: v7 objective-type battery, 8 courses, ordered mild->wild: control (PRECISION/COLLECT) -> route-under-motion (COLLECT+cart) -> rhythm (SURVIVE hammer -> SURVIVE dual-crusher) -> management (DESTROY) -> brain-teaser (PHYSICS direct -> PHYSICS bank capstone). t_cart_convoy / t_crush_corridor / t_bank_shot are the wave-2 additions. v10 completion model: BINARY completion, no clock/medal/par -- REACH_GOAL + SURVIVE run multi-player-parallel (all-must-finish); the four object-mutation types (DESTROY/PHYSICS/COLLECT/PRECISION) ship SOLO but still work single-player.
